tau2.sampling: t = floor(u * n_decisions), u = int(sha256('bank-u-v1|' + run + '|' + domain + '|' + task)[:12], 16) / 16**12; state_key = sha256('U2B|' + run + '|' + domain + '|' + task)[:16]; no stratification; failed rows kept missing

bfcl_meta.inference: BFCL's own BaseHandler.inference_multi_turn_FC loop (FC mode, OpenAI-compatible chat completions to the CLOQ vLLM agent server; MAXIMUM_STEP_LIMIT 20 per turn; miss_func holdout functions injected by the loop)
bfcl_meta.evaluator: bfcl_eval.eval_checker.eval_runner._evaluate_single_multi_turn_entry (the per-entry body of the official multi_turn_runner: decode_execute + multi_turn_checker state/response checks), unchanged

bfcl_selection.rule: per category: bfcl_mt_v1 eval ids minus the exclusion set, sorted by sha256('cloq-nmp-bfcl-v1:' + id); nmp_v1 = first 50. Ids only; no model outcome or divergence information.
